local_observations.system_status: apiserver is not running and not registered with launchd

kernel_set_b3_result.stderr_contains: Ensure container system service has been started with `container system start`.

observations: container system start starts container services and optionally installs a default kernel
enable/disable kernel install flag default is prompt user
container system status sends a health check request to the API server
container system kernel set installs or updates the Linux kernel used by the runtime
kernel download integrity for first-run system start has been a documented upstream concern
manual SHA-verified local tar workflow was discussed by upstream users
upstream discussion describes kernel resource management UX as disjointed
new-install system start is expected to download a kernel if the current default kernel is missing

assessment: Apple Container CLI 1.1.0 primary backend is blocked for the current local-only, pinned-artifact bootstrap contract. The installed CLI's local-tar kernel provisioning path still requires a running apiserver, while the apiserver did not become healthy under noninteractive start with kernel install disabled.
decision_required: authorize vendor bootstrap with container system start --enable-kernel-install, accepting network/default-kernel behavior under a new explicit contract
pause Apple Container and investigate/report vendor behavior before retrying
switch to fallback backend selection and create a separate Lima-vz supply-chain contract
